stem: Two electronic transfer events appear identical, but the physical material moved only once. What is the strongest response?
choices: Confirm physical state, transaction identifiers, timestamps, user/work-order history, and genealogy before following the authorized duplicate-event correction process
Create a second physical transfer to match the records
Ignore the duplicate because totals may still balance
rationale: A suspected duplicate must be verified against physical state and transaction genealogy before correction so the audit trail remains defensible.
